title: Model Supply Sensitivity Roadmap & Buyers' Lifecycle Scenarios
creator: Ethan Park
description:
Summary:
This ticket scopes a compact, operational playbook and a resilience matrix that maps model-supply failure modes (outage, performance regression, pricing spike) to buyer-impacted scenarios across Redwood product tiers (hosted API, Dedicated, Private). The goal is to deliver a decision-ready roadmap for (1) prioritized model-swap candidates, (2) procurement escalation triggers, and (3) playbook templates for sales/solutions when customers ask about supplier risk.

Background:
- Market signals show increased provider churn and frequent small outages for several popular open models over the last 6 months.
- Sales and SRE have requested a lightweight artifact that links observable signals (latency, availability, price-change) to recommended operational responses and pre-approved fallback model bundles.

Out of scope:
- Full legal procurement contract templates (this ticket produces triggers and ops-level guidance; legal will be looped separately).

Deliverables:
1) Resilience Matrix (CSV + one-page visual) mapping signal thresholds to recommended actions and estimated customer impact and cost delta.
2) Buyers' Lifecycle Scenarios (3 canonical personas: startup PLG, mid-market product team, regulated enterprise) with recommended default fallback bundles and communication scripts.
3) Short playbook for Sales/Solutions containing escalation steps, pre-approved substitute models, and SLA talking points.
4) Linkable artifacts: Confluence PRD, Drive workbook with data, GitHub experiment repo stub.

Approach / Milestones:
- Week 1: Stakeholder interviews (SRE, Sales, Solutions, Legal) and data pull from model-availability dashboard.
- Week 2: Build signal-to-action thresholds and assemble candidate fallback catalog (quantized variants, small-flavor models, cross-provider equivalents).
- Week 3: Run simple customer-impact cost simulation for three personas and iterate with Solutions.
- Week 4: Finalize one-page matrix, publish Confluence doc, and hand off to Sales enablement.

Acceptance criteria:
- Resilience Matrix published to Confluence with data-backed thresholds and at least 6 candidate fallbacks per high-risk model.
- Three persona scenario pages with cost/latency delta tables and canned communication templates.
- Playbook reviewed by SRE and Sales, and signed off by Solutions lead.
- Dashboard widget (link) added to Console backlog to track model availability signals used in the matrix.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Confluence doc with matrix and fallback catalog exists. 2) Solutions and SRE provided review comments and sign-off recorded. 3) Playbook contains explicit rollback/escalation steps and contact list. 4) Example buyer-facing language tested with Sales in a dry-run call.
